sourceAnalysis.sharedFixture: One beforeAll creates the embedded cluster/admin pool at startup test lines 163-236. afterAll closes it at 238-244; there is no per-test fresh database/reset.
sourceAnalysis.mutationLifetime: The exhaustive ACL sweep at lines 5254-5359 changes relation and column GRANT OPTION state and restores it in each iteration's finally. Its async callback has no test-context signal or cancellation check. Timeout does not await its complete loop before later tests reuse the database.
sourceAnalysis.runnerSemantics: Installed @vitest/runner 3.2.6 dist/chunk-hooks.js:1852-1922 rejects the outer promise on timeout and aborts context. It does not terminate the underlying async callback; this callback does not consume that context signal.
sourceAnalysis.rejectionOrder: Production startup checks app authority before operator authority, server/src/db/distributed-execution-databases.ts:1750-1782. An outstanding app ACL mutation therefore masks an operator-specific injected violation and prevents positive startup checks.
sourceAnalysis.confidence: Fixture cascade is strongly supported by the timeout, shared mutable ACL loop, lack of cancellation, wrong-phase rejection, and continuing app-authority logs during subsequent tests. The specific remaining ACL tuple was not queried; no isolated run excluding the sweep was authorized or performed, so independent product causes are not conclusively ruled out.
sourceAnalysis.additionalDiagnostic: Embedded PostgreSQL emitted a missing shared-memory-segment FATAL near shutdown at 16:39:22 UTC. Vitest reported neither a hook failure nor an unhandled-error block; no independent causal finding is inferred from this shutdown line.

followUpOnly: Make the ACL fixture cancellation-safe and ensure complete restoration/settlement before later cases, retaining full assertion coverage. Establish each positive startup journey on uncontaminated fixture state before assigning independent product defects. No source/setup changes, timeout increases, assertion relaxations or additional test rounds were made.
